planTitle.title: Plan Title
planTitle.description: Set a clear name that briefly describes the procurement goal. Example: "Robusta Coffee Procurement 2025 Season".

time.title: Registration Period
time.description: Time period allowing farmers to register for the plan. Should be long enough for farmers to prepare.

description.title: Description
description.description: Complete description of the plan, including objectives, scope, and special requirements.

processingMethod.title: Processing Method
processingMethod.description: The platform does not support fresh coffee procurement due to storage difficulties, so this selection is mandatory.

targetQuantity.title: Target Quantity
targetQuantity.description: Amount of coffee to be procured (in kg). This is the overall goal of the plan.

minRegistrationQuantity.title: Minimum Registration Quantity
minRegistrationQuantity.description: This is the quantity that farmers must register from the set minimum level and above. However, when the plan is close to reaching the target quantity, farmers are allowed to register less to ensure the plan can be completed fully.

targetRegion.title: Priority Region
targetRegion.description: Clearly define which farmers can participate (by region, coffee type, quality standards).

qualityStandards.title: Quality Standards (Described in Details)
qualityStandards.description: Requirements for coffee quality (moisture, bean size, color, taste).

importantNotes.title: Important Notes
items: Plan will be saved as Draft status after saving
Plan cannot be edited after opening for registration
Registration period should align with farmers' production cycle
Set realistic and feasible target quantities
If registration deadline has passed but target quantity is not reached, system will automatically recalculate in plan details, businesses can use this to create follow-up plans
Estimated costs do not include taxes

workflow.title: Workflow After Creating Plan
steps: Approve Registrations and Create Commitment Orders

open.title: Confirm Open Registration Process
open.description: Are you sure you want to open the registration process for plan {{planName}}? After opening, the plan will automatically update the registration start time and will be displayed on the coffee procurement platform. Farmers will be able to register for this plan. Note: The plan cannot be edited after opening.

close.title: Confirm Close Registration Process
close.description: Are you sure you want to close the registration process for plan {{planName}}? After closing, the plan will automatically update the registration end time. After closing, the plan will no longer be displayed on the coffee procurement platform and cannot be reopened. Approved commitments will continue to function normally. Note: The plan may automatically close after reaching sufficient output based on approved commitments from both parties.

cancel.title: Confirm Cancel Plan
cancel.description: Are you sure you want to cancel plan {{planName}}? After cancellation, the plan will no longer be active and will be removed from the coffee procurement platform. Farmers will no longer be able to register for this plan. The plan also cannot be reopened.

delete.title: Confirm Delete Plan
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete plan {{planName}}? This action cannot be undone.

success.opened: Plan has been opened for registration successfully
success.closed: Plan registration has been closed successfully
